capabilities: insert or update \tag{N} markers in equation environments
render \ref{key} as "Equation N" in Live Preview with editable raw text on focus
customize the prefix word before the number
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README is concise; it covers setup steps (a %\label comment per equation, \ref in text) but no screenshots or advanced examples.
problem: Obsidian's Math rendering does not automatically number equations or resolve equation cross-references, so writers must number \tag{} by hand and keep \ref values in sync themselves.
summary: Equation numbering plugin that assigns sequential numbers to labeled LaTeX equations and renders \ref{...} as live references like "Equation N".
